title.narrative: Start Fund - Somalia Alert 681 - Displacement Due to Conflict

description.narrative: Proposed project will reach 2,767 displaced households (approx. 16,605 individuals – without double counting between activities) with food and water needs. Food and water are among the topmost priority needs of affected population. While shelter and protection also remain our area of concern. With current available resources we prioritize food and water for life -saving assistance with protection mainstreaming approach while we further continue our efforts to mobilize resources for other needs like shelter/Non Food Items (NFIs). We proposed to target most vulnerable 1,253 households (7,518 people, 35 percent of total displaced in the target 7 locations) in need of food assistance with cash transfer modality using our existing mobile money transfer system in place. Following the latest Joint Markets and Supply Chain Update led by World Food Programme (WFP) dated 21 to 28 January 2023, we conducted a quick check with key informants and identified that market in the proposed seven locations is accessible and functional. Under the umbrella of Cash Working Group and in -line with our commitment to harmonize cash -based assistance in the country, we propose to adopt the food assistance cash transfer value of USD 90 (72.62 GBP) per household per month in this response. Proposed target 1,253 households to receive 180 USD (145.25 GBP) each as a food assistance for two months in one go. This will result in direct transfer of USD 225,540 (181, 992 GBP) to beneficiaries.
